posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body:
Hiya, My problem is that on my new laptop, a Legion Pro 5 16IRX8, my RPG Maker 2003 game runs at a whopping 237 frames per second, causing my game to run about 4 times faster than it should. I'm not sure of a way to fix this, be it something I need to change on my pc itself, or a change I need to make to my game, but I am in desperate need of some tech support.
I wish to limit the FPS to 60, which is what it was before.
Strangely, this seems to only affect the pictures that I used for my evented title screen, causing the sine wave to move too fast, and the spritesheet to cycle too quickly. When actually in the game, the framerate shows about same as stated above, but the actual game plays at the same speed that it is supposed to. This only affects the images on my title screen.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Every RPG Maker version has this issue with high Hertz monitors. MV has a plugin that fixes that issue. Sadly, I'm not aware of an equivalent for ancient tech like 2k3.

posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body: Ah, understood. It only affects this one part, so it's not too big of a deal, I'll just need to check with others to make sure that it runs as intended on their PCs. Thanks for replying.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Hmm, that sounds strange. Usually what happens is that the entire game runs at around 4 times speed (depending on how many hertz your monitor has). It affecting only one section would be strange.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
For MV, and likely other makes, you can manually set a frame rate limit in your gpu's driver. This works for you, the user, but obviously does not apply to anyone else.
For information on how to apply a frame limiter you can either Google your graphics manufacturer and "frame rate limiter"
Or, follow the steps in the link in my signature.

posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body: Thanks for pointing me towards refresh rate. I found the option in my pc’s settings to change it, so anytime I see something working a little screwy or fast, I can switch over and see if it’s my game, or my monitor.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I can't remember this problem only occurring on one map, if it was the whole game I would be sure you are using some modified or old RPG_RT.exe, but that's not the case.
From what I understand, your title menu is made with Picture animations, would it be possible to post a screenshot of the event?

posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body: Yea, when I get back to my computer, I’ll screenshot the events. It’s a couple of parallel processes running at once, to make the custom menu, with the pictures spritesheet animations on a loop.
